# UIA AutomationId baseline — generated by tests/uia_contract/check_uia.py.
# Each line: <relpath>:<element>:<x:Name|UNNAMED#index>
# Line numbers are deliberately NOT in the key (unrelated edits would
# trip the lint). Named controls keyed by x:Name; anonymous controls
# get a per-(file,element) document-order index — adding a new
# anonymous control of an existing element type bumps the index.
# CI passes when current violations are a subset of this list. New
# violations FAIL the build; cleanups that shrink this list are fine.
# Regenerate with: python tests/uia_contract/check_uia.py --write-baseline
